answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 29 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The trellis register is checked at draw time, sable lists the eligible set, and gale seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 29 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 20 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
